name: Hubris Condition
desc: Internal condition for filtering unique planets.

name: Failed Cryosanctum
desc: An enormous tomb-like vault built to store the DOMINT personnel who managed this blacksite in the event of enacting network failure protocol. Unfortunately for those inside, the many-times redundant support infrastructure emblematic of cryosanctums has since been dismantled and repurposed by the local drones, killing all occupants. Now rotted to dust over countless cycles, they aren't even suitable for organ harvesting operations.

desc:

name: Subsurface Ecosystem
desc: Complex aquatic organisms grow anaemic and wearily beneath the icy surface of $market, clinging to the sparse hydrothermal vents within its subterranean primordial sea. Only the immensely rare combination of traits in a prospective angler, desperate but well supplied, could make this ocean bear any amount of food grade material.

name: Standardized Atmosphere
desc: The atmosphere of $market is notable precisely for a lack of notable features. A composition so prosaic, its proverbial edges so thoroughly sanded, that it betrays the hand of strategic terraforming efforts.

name: Makeshift Solar Array
desc: This planet has an array of makeshift solar shades or mirrors in orbit, judiciously positioned to bring its surface conditions closer to terran norms.

name: Water Ice Imports
desc: $Market is the benefactor of offworld ice mining. Synthetic comets accelerated by immense mass drivers from across the system frequently streak across the sky, a dazzling display almost forgotten to the sector post-Collapse.

name: Volturnian Lobster Pens
desc: A mix of several Old Earth species and a little imagination produced this creature which now grows wild in the crushing depths of $market's sea-floor. The flavor is said to be exceptional, the secret ingredient was crime.

name: Encroaching Biofactory
desc: An unconstrained Biofactory Embryo undulates across the landscape of $market, putrid and flowing as it encroaches on human settlements, necessitating occasional orbital burns. Synthetic compounds oozing from the mass taint local water sources while disturbingly human-like organs bud, ready for harvest by armed expeditions into the mess of flesh and tendrils.

name: Eutrophicated Biosphere
desc: Rampant Soil Nanites provide a perpetual and suffocating source of nutrients to the biosphere of  $market. Immense mats of algae bloom and swirl in dizzying patterns influenced by the currents of the major oceans while organic detritus piles high, rivalling lithic structures in size.

name: Glassed World
desc: An ill-maintained Orbital Fusion Lamp has carved a large fissure into the crust of $market, forming a massive belt of slag and glass. The neighbouring large ice sheets slip slowly but inexorably closer to vaporisation by intense radiating heat, making long term habitation a troubling but lucrative proposition when these immense forces are tapped as power for industry.

name: Rebel Arsenal
desc: Hidden in the form of extensive bunker networks and hacked nanoforges is the evidence that $market was once the site of a well organised insurrection. While they failed to overcome the might of the Domain, the stockpiles of weapons and ancient military infrastructure is an immense boon to local forces.

name: Quarry Lakes
desc: Large mining runs, collapsed tunnels and deep pits perforate the crust of $market. While the resources available by conventional extraction are depleted, the local water supply is poisoned crimson with metallic elements that can be refined semi-directly at surprising levels of efficacy.

name: Logistics Complex
desc: The ruins of a Domain-Era Logistics Complex spears through the lower atmosphere of $market. Once dedicated to the Sector-wide management and distribution of restricted technologies, this installation is capable of interfacing with the Skyhook Anchor in orbit to ease logistical burdens.

name: Metastatic Sensorium
desc: Endless tracts of business parks, kinetic thrill rides and holographic sensory suites have subsumed the floating arcologies of $market. Automated drones continually add to, and fail to maintain, the ever-expanding array of attractions. Working around their activities is a constant stress on planetary operations, but with some effort these facilities can be tapped for lucrative tourism and commerce.

name: Domain-era Meshugatron
desc: Outside the tumultuous upper atmosphere of $market hangs a Domain-era Meshugatron, a technological cousin of the Synchrotron capable refining immense volumes of high-grade Antimatter Fuel intended for exclusive use by the legendary Domain Battlegroups. With some effort this infrastructure could be restored, and the edge presented by this improved fuel granted to a select few of our choosing.
